# WebSocket data streams: is this moment mine?

## What this region is

The second real-time lane, for data too incremental or frequent to refetch: streams declared once in the shared registry with a kind, ordering and required audience; opened by running the read route in-process as the grant and snapshot; appended to only through with per-stream sequence numbers and resync by snapshot, never replay; folded on the client by. Refetch channels and the client socket are the region.

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- Make the page update when this changes → ws-channels
- Push this to every subscriber on all servers → ws-connections
- I need to stop two of these running at once → concurrency-locks
- Send an email or notification after this write → app-events-webhooks
